name: Render resolution 854x480, output 854x480
description: Output and render resolution 854x480, the lightest variant. The game's defaults are an output of 3840x2160 and a render resolution of 2560x1440; this patch sets both, so the scene, the upscale, the UI and the final composition all run at the lower size. Use only one of the three variants.
author: batatinhafcbatatinha-pixel
tested: Not tested. Same four values as the tested 720p variant, with 854x480 written instead. 854 is not a multiple of 8; if the picture is wrong, try 848x480.
